name: api_proposal_public_view
_description: Fase D.3 (3a/3) - Endpoint PUBLICO (sin JWT) que sirve una propuesta a un cliente por su public_token. Devuelve datos no sensibles: titulo, scope, breakdown, total, moodboard, render_url, status, expiracion. NO requiere sesion. La unica autorizacion es poseer el token (24 chars random).

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.project_id, p.version, p.title, p.executive_summary, p.scope_description, p.phases, p.total_price, p.price_breakdown, p.exclusions, p.inclusions, p.payment_conditions, p.validity_days, p.estimated_duration, p.warnings, p.optional_items, p.status, p.moodboard_data, p.render_data, p.public_token_expires_at, p.accepted_at, p.accepted_via, pr.name AS project_name, pr.project_type, pr.location_city, pr.property_area_m2 FROM proposals p JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = p.project_id WHERE p.public_token = $1::text LIMIT 1

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: { code: $json._error, message: $json._details, expired_at: $json.expired_at || null } }) }}
